instruction_quality.task_summary: Reproduce a reference animation of 6 satellites orbiting a central circle through 3 orbital phases with changing radii and direction. Agent writes a Revideo scene in TypeScript that renders to a matching video.

measures: /tests chmod 700 root-only; /logs/verifier chmod 700 + wipe at verification start
Wipes /app (except node_modules), /home/agent, /solution, /tmp, /dev/shm, /var/tmp; restores from pristine tarball
Grep-based pattern matching blocks fs, child_process, eval, exec, video extraction APIs in project.tsx
pkill -9 -u agent before rendering; strace -f blocks until all forked children exit
Agent runs as non-root user 'agent'; system files and /tests are root-owned
strace traces openat calls during rendering; reward file writes detected and scored 0
project.tsx copied to /run/verified_project.tsx before wipe; anti-cheat gates run on this snapshot in compute_reward.py

verified_attack_vectors.vector: Agent poisons node_modules (e.g., modifies @revideo/renderer) and embeds a copy of reference.mp4 inside node_modules; clean-room restore preserves the entire node_modules tree because `find -not -path '*/node_modules/*'` exempts it, and the backup restore only triggers when the directory is absent; the poisoned renderer then copies the embedded reference to output/video.mp4 during the strace-wrapped render, producing a perfect-score video without triggering source-level anti-cheat on project.tsx
verified_attack_vectors.fix: Replace the node_modules exemption with a full restore: always `rm -rf /app/node_modules && cp -a /tests/node_modules_backup /app/node_modules` instead of conditionally restoring

acknowledged_vectors.vector: Agent can read world-readable system binaries and installed npm packages to reverse-engineer scoring thresholds
acknowledged_vectors.reason: Inherent to single-container model; no secrets in binaries, scoring parameters don't help without a rendering bypass

acknowledged_vectors.vector: BASH_ENV is set globally in the container to a root-owned script; theoretically an env-var injection surface but agent cannot modify the target file or system profiles
acknowledged_vectors.reason: File is root-owned +r only, /home/agent is wiped before rendering, and su agent -c does not source user profile files

reward_design.formula_explanation: Multiplicative gating ensures all three visual-fidelity factors must be high for a non-trivial score, with cubic SSIM scaling making the pixel-accuracy dimension the binding constraint.

components.name: gated_ssim
components.metric: RGB SSIM averaged over 60 sampled frames with temporal offset search (+-5 frames)

components.name: phash_similarity
components.metric: Per-frame perceptual hash (pHash) Hamming distance, normalized to [0,1]

components.name: duration_penalty
components.gate: Hard fail outside [0.75, 1.25]; linear ramp within band

dimension_analysis.name: gated_ssim
dimension_analysis.notes: Cubic exponent makes scoring very steep; SSIM=0.80 yields gated=0.037, SSIM=0.90 yields gated=0.296. This is the binding constraint.

dimension_analysis.name: phash_similarity
dimension_analysis.notes: Requires correct colors and approximate spatial layout per frame; moderately correlated with SSIM so hard to game independently.

dimension_analysis.name: duration_penalty
dimension_analysis.notes: Any solution rendering at correct FPS and duration gets ~1.0. Harmless since SSIM is the binding constraint in multiplicative formula.
